rateros.escapo: A bandit escaped with %s of your things.
rateros.error.clave: There is no setting "%s". Use /bandits ajustes to see the list.
rateros.error.lugar: No place found for them to arrive. Try somewhere more open.
rateros.retirados: %s bandits removed (they dropped what they carried).
rateros.estado.dia: World day %s: %s%% chance of a gang per day (%s).
rateros.ajustes.ayuda: Change one with /bandits ajustes <key> <value>. Lists are edited in config/rateros/ajustes.json.
rateros.aj.hurto_ayuda: T = thief, C = crossbowman, B = breaker, Bo = boss. The theft level multiplies what they carry (Soft x0.5, Aggressive x2, Ruthless no limit) and the chance of valuables.
rateros.aj.listas_ayuda: The lists (what is valuable, what they never steal, what they ignore and which blocks they can break) are edited in ajustes.json. Open it with the button below, save it and press "Reload file".
rateros.aj.niveles_ayuda: Gang size and weapons depend on the best you have obtained (ingots, blocks or gems in your inventory, ender chest or nearby chests): nothing = 2 thieves; iron or lapis = 2-3; gold, emerald or redstone = 3-4; diamond = 4-6 and maybe the boss; netherite = 5-8 with boss. Some gangs (the % above) come from a random lower level. They never carry enchantments. The table is edited in the file (button below).
rateros.pantalla.restaurado: Original values restored (the raids switch stays as it was).
rateros.aj.buscarCama: Find your bed if they smell nothing
